## Summarize Genomic Prediction Results {.unnumbered}


### Description

Detailed summary of a fitted <code>masreml</code> object including model
information, variance components table, heritability, and GEBV
distribution per component. For binary traits, also reports AUC
and heritability on liability and observed scales.



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>## S3 method for class 'masreml'
summary(object, ...)
</code></pre>
